plan.title: Filter participants by city after publish

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation as required by the case.
Set the event type to RFQ.
Apply the RFQ pricing template so the sourcing sheet is available.
Add the specified product and quantity.
Set the requested delivery location on the first line item.
Add the mapped QA vendors available for this company.
Publish the event so its Participants tab can be tested.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Open the published stage's Participants list.

args.goal: On the buyer's Participants screen, use the Filter by city control to select a city, verify that only vendors from that city are listed, clear the city filter, and verify that the full vendor list is shown again.

steps.note: Perform and verify the city filtering and clearing behavior directly on the buyer-side screen.
Confirm the run ends on the Participants screen after the filter checks.
